member.name: M:ICS.LabelPrinting.PrintTypes.Base.Loftware.AppendDTDFilePath
member.summary:
Gets the DTD file path header to append to the Xml dropfile based on the version of Loftware. The version is determined by retrieving the Version value from [HKEY_LOCALMACHINE]\Software\ Loftware, Inc.\Loftware Programs within the registry. NOTE: The Version registry key value does not exist prior to version 7.0.
The DTD file path is NOT necessary for Loftware version 8.0.2.11 or greater. SCR - BD013727.
member.returns: Returns the DTD File Path Header if the Loftware version is older than 8.0.2.11 or the Loftware registry key is not available; otherwise, an empty string.

member.returns: Returns 1 if A is greater than B, 0 if A is equal to B; otherwise, -1.
